findings.issue: Unrelated formatting churn: a BOM was added to line 1 and unrelated lines were reindented (catalogtypes/catalogbrands handlers, BadRequest/NotFound initializers), which adds noise to the diff.

FetchBasketAsync now looks up catalog details for saved products as well. If a saved product is no longer in the catalog, `catalogItems[item.ProductId]` throws KeyNotFoundException and breaks the whole cart page and the header badge, which only need the cart items. Saved products are long-lived, so

The save, move and remove handlers do not handle RpcException NOT_FOUND. A stale page or a double submit, for example saving a product that was already moved, surfaces as an unhandled error instead of a refreshed cart.

DeleteBasketAsync, UpdateBasket and the move operations each read the basket, modify it and write it back without an atomic check. A concurrent save or move can be overwritten by a delete that was based on an older read.
